description: ImagineClip is an AI creation platform for generating fun videos, avatar clips, stylized scenes, and shareable social content from prompts, images, and effects. Users can start with a text idea, upload a portrait or reference image, or transform an existing visual into a short-form clip. The product combines text-to-video, image-to-video, video-to-video, and AI image editing in one place.
